characters.description: Thameland's returned General and an accomplished wizard. When Ravener spawn begin alternating between violence and unexpected aid, Alex searches for the cause while developing a way to stop the Ravener from returning after its next defeat.
characters.name: Alex Roth

characters.description: Alex's fiancee and trusted frontline partner. A skilled warrior who fights beside her familiar Brutus, she remains part of the close group preparing to defend Thameland and bring the Ravener's repeating cycle to a permanent end.
characters.name: Theresa

characters.description: Alex's sapient golem son and steadfast protector. Claygon assists the search for the Ravener and supports Thameland's defense, combining formidable constructed strength with an independent mind and a deep bond with the person he calls father.
characters.name: Claygon

characters.description: Theresa's familiar and constant combat companion. He accompanies her in Thameland's defense and belongs to the central circle supporting Alex's effort to survive the war and end the Ravener's cycle.
characters.name: Brutus

characters.description: A Rhinean noblewoman, lightning mage, and established member of Alex's allied circle. She continues the group's research and war preparations while approaching the completion of her own studies at the University of Generasi.
characters.name: Isolde

characters.description: Thameland's dead former deity and the creator of the Ravener. His missing corpse and throne are central targets of the search, while the mechanisms he left behind continue to shape the heroes, the realm, and the enemy they must destroy.
characters.name: Uldar

characters.description: Thameland's cycle-bound enemy, created by Uldar and capable of returning after physical destruction. Its spawn now behave in bafflingly different ways, with some committing massacres while others rescue and provision mortals, leaving its intentions uncertain.
characters.name: The Ravener

characters.description: A knight commander who reports a wider pattern of Ravener spawn aiding people across Thameland.
characters.name: Sir Sean Swift

characters.description: A rising divine power linked to Alex and increasingly worshiped in Thameland. Alex wonders whether her influence explains the helpful Ravener spawn, and her growing strength may be essential to the effort against the Ravener.
characters.name: Hannah Kim

characters.description: Alex's lizardfolk mana-manipulation professor and mentor, who regards him as an exceptional and diligent student.
characters.name: Professor Val'Rok

characters.description: A goblin wizard serving as Professor Salinger's assistant at Greymoor, where he works near the growing eld tree.
characters.name: Keebus

characters.description: Keebus's crocodile familiar, enlarged to the size of a tree and protected by heavy armor. Custom potions and dungeon-core work let him overcome bone chargers and other large predators.
characters.name: Harmless

characters.description: Alex's younger sister and a developing fire mage. She remains at Greymoor while Alex prepares for the coming war, part of the family whose safety and future give his campaign personal stakes beyond strategy.
characters.name: Selina Roth

characters.description: The University of Generasi's chancellor, an ancient archwizard, and one of Alex's principal mentors. He unexpectedly returns after an extended absence while Alex studies the Ravener's fear and restoration mechanisms.
characters.name: Baelin

characters.description: A senior researcher developing a poison from Uldar's material for use against the Ravener. She and Alex divide the permanent-kill problem between alchemical work and the study of the enemy's fear and restoration mechanisms.
characters.name: Vernia Jules

characters.description: A fallen member of the earlier expedition whose death weighs heavily on the research group. Her loss is confirmed when Baelin returns, and grief over the choices surrounding her final battle strains the allies who survived her.
characters.name: Carey London

characters.description: A divine hero and healer who joins the anti-Ravener research while burdened by guilt over Carey. He recognizes that the enemy's fear-derived power cannot simply be handled like mana and helps seek a religious countermeasure.
characters.name: Merzhin

characters.description: A veteran ally and Björgrund's father who has long lived without his left leg. He consents to become the first major test of Merzhin's newly strengthened Mark of the Saint, with his son present in support.
characters.name: Birger

characters.description: Birger's son and an ally of Alex's group. He is present when Merzhin begins an experimental healing and supports his father's decision to undergo it.
characters.name: Björgrund

characters.description: The dragon hero known as the Sage of Thameland. She volunteers to take part in Alex's next effort to unlock the hidden potential of a hero mark.
characters.name: Drestra

characters.description: The martial hero known as the Champion of Thameland. He joins the continuing fight against Ravener spawn alongside Merzhin, Claygon, Birger, and allied soldiers.
characters.name: Hart Red Fletcher

characters.description: One of Alex's closest cabal allies and a gifted spellcaster with a talent for languages. He develops simultaneous verbal and movement-based casting while helping prepare the heroes and their allies for the final campaign.
characters.name: Khalik

characters.description: An illusionist and member of Alex's cabal who fights Ravener spawn and supports the group's intensive training. His magic contributes to the combined arms and spellcraft the allies are building before the decisive confrontation.
characters.name: Thundar

characters.description: Thameland's high priest, preparing to tell the realm that the improved hero marks and battlefield aid point toward the Traveler's growing power. He sees public belief as a practical part of strengthening Thameland's defense.
characters.name: High Priest Tobias J.

characters.description: The Chosen of Thameland and the final hero Alex must train before testing the General's own reward. His demanding program must unite prayer, combat movement, mana control, spellcasting, and the disciplines represented by the other heroes.
characters.name: Cedric

characters.description: An allied fighter who can openly wield one of Uldar's weapons as Thameland's forces prepare for the campaign against the Ravener.
characters.name: Asmoldester

characters.description: A Fae Lord strongly implicated in the Ravener's hidden Feywild operation. He possesses Uldar's throne, and the loose wording of his pact with three Thameish heroes leaves him dangerous freedom to act against their realm.
characters.name: Aenflynn

characters.description: Thameland's king, gravely wounded while defending his wife and infant son during the Ravener's assault on the capital. After receiving emergency healing, he remains with the city's defenders instead of withdrawing from the siege.
characters.name: King Athelstan Mercier

characters.description: Alex's golem-business partner and a supplier of heavy magical constructs. During Thameland's kingdom-wide emergency, she offers a reserve force stronger than the ordinary dungeon-core golems Alex first requests.
characters.name: Taraka Shale

characters.description: A Ravener hunter and ally of Theresa who joins the expedition into the Feywild.
characters.name: Grimloch

characters.description: An Asrai survivor who witnesses Alex's force destroy Ravener spawn and enter a mushroom-circle gate. His encounter with the strike team places him near the opening of the direct Thameish intervention in Och Fir Nog.
characters.name: Gwilain

characters.description: An Ulrich guard restored by Hannah when Ravener spawn attack the town.
characters.name: Peter

characters.description: An Ulrich guard whom Hannah saves from lethal venom during the Ravener spawn attack.
characters.name: Paul

characters.description: A war spirit also known as Asmoldester. She uses greater power against the Ravener because her summoner promised a battle of extraordinary scale.
characters.name: The Unmaker

characters.description: A young bakery assistant mistreated by Macarras. Alex provides funds and proposes a job in the Roth family's future Ulrich bakery.
characters.name: Martin

characters.description: Alex's summoning professor, whose observation of Alex's ninth-tier summoning removes the need for a practical examination and supports a recommendation for graduation.
characters.name: Professor Mangle

characters.description: Grimloch's older sister and a graduating wizard. She plans to continue her studies through research into tidal magic.
characters.name: Nua-Oge

characters.description: A spirit-killer whom Alex unexpectedly meets again at the Whetstone Tavern while seeking reinforcements for Thameland.
characters.name: Kiembe

characters.description: A former king whom Alex unexpectedly meets again at the Whetstone Tavern while seeking reinforcements for Thameland.
characters.name: Azarak Kai
